solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The noun "**foundation**" refers to the basis or groundwork of anything.
 
• In this context,** "the foundation of a strong community" **emphasizes the fundamental role families play in building a strong and cohesive community.
 
• The other options: "**undermining**", "**erosion**", and "**collision**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** Family plays a vital role in our lives, serving as a source of love, support, and stability. It is within the family unit that we develop lasting bonds, learn essential values, and find comfort during challenging times. Families provide a nurturing environment for personal growth and emotional well-being. They offer guidance, share experiences, and create cherished memories. The strength and cohesion of a family contribute to individual happiness, societal harmony, and the foundation__ of a strong community.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Undermining (कमजोर करना)**: means to damage or weaken someone or something gradually.
 
• **Erosion (अपक्षय)**: means the gradual destruction or diminution of something.
 
• **Collision (टक्कर)**: means an instance of one moving object or person striking violently against another.
